response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep technical craftsmanship, and a track record of building scalable systems and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading enterprise-scale experimentation platforms, AI-driven growth systems, or cross-team instrumentation frameworks — key requirements for a Principal IC6 role.
strengths: Proven experience building scalable, high-throughput systems (e.g., DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong open-source contributions and tooling development (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) demonstrating initiative and systems thinking
Broad technical versatility across languages (TypeScript, D, C++, Python-like exposure) and domains (web, mobile, embedded, DevOps)
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or owning experimentation frameworks, feature flagging systems, or growth measurement platforms at scale
Limited visibility into data-driven decision-making, statistical analysis, or bias/risk controls in experimentation contexts
AI tooling experience is mentioned vaguely (AI-agent infrastructure) without concrete impact or integration examples
